title: Unsubscribe error route has no direct regression coverage
reasoning: The feature is the public Django route named unsubscribe_error, but the included tests only exercise generation of the primary unsubscribe URL and email template links. None of the provided tests reverse or request notifications:unsubscribe_error, so a typo in the URL pattern, route name, or view binding for the error page could ship without these tests failing.
recommendation: Add a focused URL/view test for reverse('notifications:unsubscribe_error') and a GET request asserting the expected status code and rendered error-page behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests validate promotional email generation, device token endpoints, admin flows, image models, push payloads, and batch/race behavior. The unsubscribe-related assertions reference notifications:unsubscribe and generated email links, not the unsubscribe_error route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Django TestCase that calls reverse('notifications:unsubscribe_error'), asserts it resolves to /hub/notifications/unsubscribe/error/ in the mounted URL configuration or /unsubscribe/error/ within the app namespace, then client.get()s the route and verifies the expected 200 response/template or redirect contract.
minimumFixScope: Add a route-level test for notifications:unsubscribe_error; no production code change is implied unless the new test reveals a mismatch.
